# Phase 8B screening API fixtures

These fixtures are synthetic and deterministic. The catalog and mapping registries contain a single active official-list component that is bound to the Phase 8A three-record Rust memory-mapped package. Requests cover exact name retrieval, exact typed-identifier retrieval, no-candidate behavior, an unmapped alert-list blocker, batch ordering, and idempotent replay.

The fixtures do not represent a production sanctions list and must not be used for regulatory screening.
